text.String: Scene Assembly | Scene graph authoring, set dressing, layout, and asset placement.
Sculpt And Model | Poly modeling, sculpt strokes, remesh, and topology shaping.
Material And Lookdev | Shader graphs, texture baking, surface libraries, and preview lighting.
Rig And Animation | Rig graphs, deformation checks, clips, retargeting, and blocking.
Simulation And FX | Caches, solvers, scene events, and reproducible simulation jobs.
Render And Composite | Viewport renders, frame products, AOV assembly, and compositor rebuilds.
Publish And Automation | Package review, delivery reports, automation jobs, and runtime pack promotion.
Scene Foundation Pack | Scene graph, transforms, collections, and viewport bindings.
Asset Ingest Pack | Asset intake schemas, package staging, and source provenance.
Modeling Ops Pack | Modeling tools, topology mutations, and authoring operators.
Sculpt Runtime Pack | Brush profiles, sculpt previews, and native mutation surfaces.
Material Graph Pack | Material graphs, shader previews, and bake metadata.
Rig Runtime Pack | Rig controls, graph projections, and deformation contracts.
Animation Clip Pack | Clip state, timing, markers, and retargeting support.
Simulation Cache Pack | Cache roots, solver manifests, and replay state.
Bootstrap Suite | project.bootstrap | Seeds the canonical scene, asset, preview, tensor, and publish session state.
Switch Workspace | workspace.switch_mode | Moves the operator into a different DCC lane and marks downstream surfaces for refresh.
Ingest Package | asset.ingest_package | Stages a new asset package into the suite ingest lane and updates runtime pack bookkeeping.
Activate Tool | tool.activate | Changes the active authoring tool and updates tool preset context.
Set Selection | selection.set | Replaces the live entity selection and updates lane inspectors.
Apply Sculpt Stroke | sculpt.apply_stroke | Queues a sculpt stroke through the native mutation seam and marks downstream lanes dirty.
Rebuild Topology | topology.rebuild | Refreshes topology and graph health analysis against current scene resources.
Sync Rig Controls | rig.sync_controls | Synchronizes rig projections and deformation reports.
Tick Simulation | sim.tick | Requests the next simulation planning tick and marks cache products dirty.
Bake Material Preview | material.bake_preview | Refreshes material preview buffers through the GPU compute lane.
Render Preview | render.preview | Stages a preview render refresh and updates render-facing reports.
Rebuild Composite | compositor.rebuild | Refreshes the compositor rebuild plan for the current frame products.
Package Publish | publish.package | Builds the publish summary and package receipts for operator review.
Tensor Train Step | tensor.train_step | Stages a tensor-oriented training plan and readiness report.
Tensor Infer Step | tensor.infer_step | Stages a tensor-oriented inference plan and readiness report.
Viewport Stage | viewport3d | Primary 3D authoring viewport for scene, model, rig, and render review.
Scene Graph | tree | Hierarchy, collections, instancing groups, and publish roots.
Asset Ingest | tree | USD, GLTF, material, groom, cache, and runtime pack intake.
Tool Shelf | inspector | Context-sensitive authoring tools across sculpt, material, rig, sim, and publish.
Selection Inspector | inspector | Transforms, metadata, relationships, and lane-specific detail panels.
Material Graph | graph | Shading, lookdev, texture-routing, and baking graph surface.
Rig Graph | graph | Control rigs, constraints, deformation layers, and sync reports.
Animation Timeline | timeline | Clips, simulation triggers, preview markers, and publish cut ranges.
Simulation Board | graph | Cache plans, solver dependencies, and replay diagnostics.
Render Lounge | graph | Render products, preview budgets, frame queues, and AOV targets.
Compositor Stack | graph | Composite rebuild plans, mattes, passes, and grading nodes.
Publish Console | inspector | Packages, receipts, validators, deliverables, and client-facing summaries.
Report Browser | inspector | Topology, tensor, render, automation, and publish reports.
Jobs Monitor | timeline | Background jobs, Fabric sessions, automation schedules, and retry state.
Select | Selection, hierarchy filtering, and transform handoff.
Kitbash Placement | Scene placement, snap rules, and collection instancing.
Poly Extrude | Poly modeling, shelling, and local face edits.
Clay Sculpt | Brush-based form sculpting through the native mutation seam.
Voxel Rebuild | Topology reset, remesh, and high-level volume cleanup.
Material Layer Paint | Mask, ID, and procedural material layer authoring.
Texture Bake | GPU-assisted preview and baking workflows.
Control Rig Edit | Rig graph authoring, control bindings, and solver metadata edits.
Clip Blocking | Timing, pose blocking, and clip state management.
Cache Solver | Simulation cache planning and replay orchestration.
Render Preview | Viewport preview renders, AOV toggles, and render queue staging.
Comp Rebuild | Composite plan refresh and pass composition inspection.
Publish Bundle | Delivery package generation, report emission, and runtime pack promotion.

scene://current/graph | value | Canonical scene graph bootstrap document authored by Kain.
asset://catalog/current | value | Asset ingest and package catalog bootstrap document.
buffer://preview/source | shared_buffer | Source preview and material bake buffer.
buffer://preview/destination | shared_buffer | Destination preview and material bake buffer populated by GPU compute.
image://preview/current | shared_image | Preview image projected into viewport, render, and publish surfaces.
buffer://tensor/features | shared_buffer | Feature buffer staged for tensor-oriented training and inference planning.
buffer://sculpt/delta | shared_buffer | Latest sculpt mutation payload emitted by the C ABI seam.
report://session/bootstrap | Bootstrap summary for suite session state.
report://asset/ingest | Asset ingest session report.
report://topology/current | Graph and topology health report.
report://rig/sync | Rig sync and deformation readiness report.
report://simulation/tick-plan | Simulation planning report for the current frame tick.
report://render/preview | Render preview planning report.
report://compositor/rebuild | Compositor rebuild planning report.
report://tensor/training | Tensor training readiness and plan report.
report://tensor/inference | Tensor inference readiness and serving report.
artifact://publish/summary | Publish and delivery summary emitted through the Node bridge.
python_suite_bootstrap | python | Seeds project defaults, workspace selection, preview sizing, runtime pack counts, and tensor readiness hints.
dcc_suite_seed | kain | Authors the scene graph bootstrap, asset catalog bootstrap, preview buffers, tensor features, and session report.
native_sculpt_kernel | c_abi | Uses the native helper to apply a narrow sculpt mutation proof and emit a sculpt signature.
rig_graph_analysis | rust_crate | Builds graph and topology health reporting from authored scene and sculpt outputs.
tensor_train_stage | python | Emits PyTorch-oriented training readiness and plan summaries without pretending the runtime is fully wired.
tensor_infer_stage | python | Emits tensor inference readiness and model-serving summaries.
gpu_material_preview | gpu_compute | Runs a compute preview and material bake pass across the shared preview buffers.
publish_suite_report | kain | Builds the publish and package report through a Kain-authored bridge into Node reporting.
Thumbnail Refresh | on_asset_ingest | Refreshes asset thumbnails and preview products after ingest.
Nightly Material Rebake | nightly | Rebuilds preview materials and cached bake outputs.
Rig Health Audit | on_publish_candidate | Recomputes rig and graph health before publish promotion.
Simulation Cache Warmup | on_scene_open | Stages warm caches for repeatable simulation review.
Tensor Readiness Probe | manual_or_nightly | Checks tensor lane readiness and records PyTorch availability without forcing runtime completion.
Publish Receipt Archive | on_publish | Archives publish receipts and operator-facing reports.
